name: Summoning Ritual
source:
A stormy night, a ritual, and a willing partner – what could go wrong? Everything. The spell backfires, releasing a horde of demons. Your partner is possessed, the house is crawling with threats, and you are not a fighter. 

Explore, strategize, or escape – the night will test every choice you make.

[From [url=https://corrocerous.itch.io/summoning-ritual]Itch.io[/url]]
